description: A Java source file defining the GiftCertificateServices class, which provides services for managing gift certificates within the OFBiz framework. The class includes methods for creating, adding funds, redeeming, checking balance, processing fulfillment, and tracking gift certificate transactions, including handling email notifications and refunds.

classes.name: GiftCertificateServices
classes.description: A service class providing functionalities for gift certificate management, including creation, funding, redemption, authorization, refund, and tracking within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: createGiftCertificate
methods.description: Creates a new gift certificate, possibly generating account details, transaction, and returning the certificate info.

methods.name: addFundsToGiftCertificate
methods.description: Adds funds to an existing gift certificate, updating the balance accordingly.

methods.name: redeemGiftCertificate
methods.description: Redeems a gift certificate against an order, reducing the balance if sufficient funds are available.

methods.name: checkGiftCertificateBalance
methods.description: Checks and returns the current available balance of a gift certificate, validating PIN if required.

methods.name: giftCertificateProcessor
methods.description: Processes the fulfillment of a gift certificate, capturing the authorization and completing the transaction.

methods.name: giftCertificateAuthorize
methods.description: Authorizes a gift certificate for a specified amount, pending actual redemption.

methods.name: giftCertificateRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund of a gift certificate purchase.

methods.name: giftCertificateRelease
methods.description: Releases a gift certificate authorization, effectively voiding it.

methods.name: giftCertificateRestore
methods.description: Restores funds to a gift certificate, used during reloads or refunds.

methods.name: giftCertificatePurchase
methods.description: Handles the purchase and fulfillment process of a gift certificate, including survey responses and email notifications.

methods.name: giftCertificateReload
methods.description: Reloads an existing gift certificate with additional funds based on survey response data.

methods.name: createFulfillmentRecord
methods.description: Tracks and records the fulfillment event of a gift certificate, storing details such as card number, amount, and response code.

methods.name: refundGcPurchase
methods.description: Processes refunds for gift certificate purchases.
